limitations: All regions remain conservative/excluded; no calibrated confidence or metric scale.
People, reflective stage, glass, water, emissions and broadcast typography distort monocular depth.
Cross-frame raw or normalized values are not absolute distances.
Only fixed-object structural hypotheses are compared; time-specific light state is not shape.
